steps.name: Epilogue ~ Hide and Seek
steps.objective: Check out the conversation with the customer who came to [Shiina] in the “Magic Academy Lobby.”

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sister… ?
(Shiina is surprised to see the person who came to see her, but runs over and hugs her with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sister!

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Shiina, how are you?
(Dayna strokes Shiina's head as she is held in her arms. Then, she pushes her back slightly as if she is about to fall.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Little sister, I'm sorry. You almost fell because of me, right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If you fall, you'll roll down to the plains of El Anor.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: My sister too. But you didn't even contact me, what kind of wind is blowing? It's not like the chairman started the affair... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I came because I had something to say to Principal Chloris and Chairman Zephyros. I also wanted to see my lovely little brother's face.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Speaking of that story, can I also hear it?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Shiina, this older sister… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sister, I am also a member of the royal family. My sister's job is also my job, so why hesitate?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Even if you say that, not today. But I promise. I will tell you when the time comes.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'll wait, little sister. instead… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Instead?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: We eat together at a restaurant. I'll be satisfied with that for today.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yeah.
(The moment Dayna is about to tap Shiina's shoulder, she withdraws her hand. Then, she quickly picks up her cane and walks in front of Shiina.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Shiina, come behind me.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sister?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It's gone.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yeah, I think it's okay. disappeared... .
(Dana looks back in surprise at Shiina’s words.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Shiina? What did you say just now? Disappearing... . Shiina… ,

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Since when did you feel this way?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Just learning magic... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's not something you can feel through magic. This is... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'm sorry, sister. and… , sister?
(Dayna quietly pulls Shiina into her arms.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Don't say you're sorry. Because our youngest hasn’t done anything wrong. This is... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Little sister, Your Majesty… . No, don't hate your big sister.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay, okay.
(Dayna holds Shiina's hand and smiles lightly.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'll tell you something special this time.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sister?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Please guide me to Chairman Zephyrus and Principal Chloris. And when it's over, let's eat right away.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, little sister. The restaurant menu today is good.
(Just like that, Dayna and Shiina disappear, and a girl who appears to have been looking at them for a long time appears.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I thought I could hide in this place full of magic, but I can't do it here either.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: What happened to those two people? .

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It's not my place to interfere... . Ah, I have to go.
(The girl tries to turn around, but bumps into someone. When the person she hit falls over, the girl quickly helps her up.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. for a moment… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Found it, kitten.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Who are you? By the way, why are you calling me a cat? ?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Me? I am the leader of a passing mercenary group.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: How did you recognize me? I'm sure I won't be visible to ordinary humans... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'm used to finding cats, kitten. Come on, let's go.  There's someone who commissioned me to find you. Do you want to go together?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's your choice whether to go or not. Of course, if you're curious about that person, you should follow me.
(In a space where you can only hear the sound of a bonfire, someone is sitting alone in front of it, and someone is singing.)
The promised night I had been waiting for... , singing a hopeful curse ♬
In order for your wish to come true, you have to do things you don't want to do♩
La la la, la la la... .
You have to survive.
Don't die, just hold on as long as you can♬
Because there are people who sing blood songs without ceasing... .
La la la, la la la... .
Our story continues like this... .
God, our God who ran away.
Hear the song that the curse you made sings. Please leave us alone.
So that I can sing all the remaining songs before the night is over... .
Night of the Witch, I hope you don’t become a sacrifice that night… .
(Before the song ends, the bonfire goes out and the surroundings are plunged into darkness.)
Boom.
(After someone who was the main character of the song falls down, a new person sits in front of him and starts the bonfire again.)
(And then resume singing where you stopped.)
Girl. Girl who has become a new god.
Please! Please close your eyes to us♬
[Chapter 4: Night of the Witch]
